title: Third Side Validity Check #5

title: Exterior Angle Inequality Theorem #7
text: Which statement correctly expresses the Exterior Angle Inequality Theorem?
options: An exterior angle is strictly smaller than any interior angle
An exterior angle of a triangle is strictly greater in measure than either of its remote interior angles
The sum of an exterior angle and remote interior angles is always 90°
An exterior angle is equal to the adjacent interior angle
answer: An exterior angle of a triangle is strictly greater in measure than either of its remote interior angles
steps: $$\text{Since angles are positive, } m\angle_{ext} > m\angle_{int1} \text{ and } m\angle_{ext} > m\angle_{int2}$$
**Final Verified Answer:** \(An exterior angle of a triangle is strictly greater in measure than either of its remote interior angles\)

title: Hinge Theorem Comparison #8
text: In triangles ABC and DEF, AB = DE, AC = DF, and m∠A = 65° while m∠D = 48°. Apply the Hinge Theorem (SAS Inequality) to compare the lengths of BC and EF.
options: BC > EF (because included angle m∠A = 65° > m∠D = 48°)
Cannot be compared without side lengths
answer: BC > EF (because included angle m∠A = 65° > m∠D = 48°)
steps: **Final Verified Answer:** \(BC > EF (because included angle m∠A = 65° > m∠D = 48°)\)
formula: m\angle A > m\angle D \implies BC > EF
